_doc: Frozen synthetic corpus for the plan loop lab (labs/plan-loop/harness.py). Every person, item and event is invented. One ask per line: who speaks, what they say, the plan a scripted planner returns for it ([tool, args, part, fault?, needs?]), parts the planner had no tool for, and what must come out (ran:done/failed/uncertain/skipped | refused:<reason> | none = handed back to today's path). Faults: fail | reject | lie | hang | write_then_hang | error | silent_write | inject. Do not edit an ask to make a run pass: add a new one.
